feature: Extract duplicated ListingsFilterBar component into shared @xala/ds package
workflow_rationale: This is a code deduplication refactor. The ListingsFilterBar component is 90%+ identical in minside and backoffice apps (687 and 682 lines respectively). Extracting to a shared component eliminates maintenance burden and prevents divergence. This follows the standard refactor pattern: Add New → Migrate → Remove Old → Cleanup.
